description: Review a branch already pushed to GitHub, with no upload: MergeSafe reads the branch's changes from GitHub itself. Returns review_id with status 'fetching' (queued). Poll get_session_findings until this review is 'quoted', then show the user its price as for review_local and ask them to confirm before confirm_review. A branch MergeSafe cannot read is refused with a note, and nothing is charged for it.

base.description: The branch the change is against.

name: review_branch
title: Review a pushed branch
